## Goal
- Complete a safe, owner-gated end-to-end IVX autonomous-worker audit and deployment verification, including secret-safe environment configuration review.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Preserve Supabase JWT registered-owner authorization; do not bypass, expose, print, commit, manufacture, or share credentials, tokens, HMAC material, or secret values.
- Preserve HMAC, expiring, single-use, exact action/SHA-bound worker authorization.
- Do not impersonate the dedicated worker, forge approvals, weaken authorization, bypass approvals, or manufacture production evidence.
- Public chat policy blocks must be HTTP `200` renderable turns; authorization failures remain `401`/`403`.
- Publish only reviewed source to `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest`; exclude unrelated `.rork/history/main/*.json` and `ios-ivx-holdings/` changes.
- Do not claim autonomous GitHub mutation, Render mutation, signed approval consumption, or final `VERIFIED` status without fresh proof.
- Do not submit to Google Play, App Store, or TestFlight.

## Progress
### Done
- Published prior website correction release:
  - GitHub commit: `c7ca154b39f2db7e0a7597d146783d87098c9c8d`
  - message: `fix: repair production landing API contract`.
- Published the reviewed autonomous-worker repair to authorized GitHub `main`:
  - commit: `9566249e9d97bb5e6e8ee689bc95457e16ab9011`
  - message: `fix: harden autonomous worker approvals and deployment flow`
  - GitHub commit URL: `https://github.com/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest/commit/9566249e9d97bb5e6e8ee689bc95457e16ab9011`.
- Publication was pinned to `GITHUB_REPO='ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest'` after detecting stale alias `ibb142/IvXHOLDING-`.
- Verified API and dedicated worker deployment parity:
  - API `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`, deployment `dep-d9i27jernols738pugkg`, live on `9566249e9d97bb5e6e8ee689bc95457e16ab9011`.
  - Worker `srv-d9i15fg4n6ts73bn00j0`, deployment `dep-d9i27jmrnols738puh1g`, live on `9566249e9d97bb5e6e8ee689bc95457e16ab9011`.
  - GitHub `main`, `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health`, and Render deployments reported the same SHA.
- Focused regression evidence passed:
  - `bun test backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts`: `16 pass`, `0 fail`.
  - Prior recovery/authorization/worker release battery: `35 passed, 0 failed`.
  - `git diff --check` passed.
- Live security behavior verified:
  - Unsigned `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/internal-deployment-authorizations/consume` returns HTTP `401`, not `404`.
  - Response includes `secretValuesReturned:false`.
  - Public `POST /api/public/chat` deployment request returns HTTP `200` with renderable `STATE: BLOCKED` and `BLOCKER_CODE: OWNER_SESSION_MISSING`.
- Owner-authorized production evidence was successfully read using an authenticated owner session:
  - `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/status`: HTTP `200`, `ok:true`, `ownerOnly:true`, `secretValuesReturned:false`.
  - `GET /api/ivx/owner-audit/recent-conversations`: HTTP `200`, `1` conversation.
  - `GET /api/ivx/audit-jobs`: HTTP `200`, `0` jobs.
  - `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/ledger`: HTTP `200`, `25` entries, `secretValuesReturned:false`.
  - `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs`: HTTP `200`, `25` entries, `secretValuesReturned:false`.
- A real owner-approved autonomous drill was submitted:
  - `GITHUB_WRITE` approval `3857302f-d0d8-4429-aa88-ffbf21612ffd`.
  - Bound SHA: `9566249e9d97bb5e6e8ee689bc95457e16ab9011`.
  - Task: `87a89317-add6-4e6d-a542-87176dd17877`.
  - Requested exactly one non-functional comment change in `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-client.ts`.
- The real drill failed safely before any source write:
  - terminal status: `FAILED`
  - checkpoint: `FAILED`
  - proof ledger ID: `fb964d41-ce36-447c-bcb2-0748ce1b4128`
  - error: `PLANNING failed: AI gateway key not configured (OPENAI_API_KEY or AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY).`
  - `filesChanged:[]`, `commitSha:null`, `renderDeployId:null`, `runtimeSha:null`.
  - GitHub approval was not consumed; no GitHub write or new Render deployment occurred.
- `rork-agent logs backend --limit 100` returned `No backend logs found for this project.`
- A Swift IVX app shell was created at `ios-ivx-holdings/` and its build passed after replacing placeholder UI:
  - `functions.runChecks` result: `Build completed successfully`.

### In Progress
- Audit configured IVX environment-variable presence and secret-safety controls.
- Run focused backend authorization and autonomous-worker validation.
- Verify live production services and owner-gated boundaries.
- Record audit evidence and unresolved production blockers.

### Blocked
- Full live autonomous deployment verification is blocked by the dedicated worker’s missing AI planning credential:
  - `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` must be configured server-side on `ivx-senior-dev-01`.
- The later secure variable request did not populate `IVX_OWNER_SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`:
  - shell evidence: `ownerTokenConfigured=false`.
  - Bearer request returned HTTP `401`: `IVX auth guard failed: missing bearer token.`
- Owner credential-audit endpoint attempt returned HTTP `409`; no credential presence report was obtained from that endpoint.
- No post-commit `RENDER_DEPLOY` approval can be created until a worker-produced commit exists.
- Full root typecheck remains blocked by unrelated baseline errors, including:
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(82,39): error TS2339: Property 'totalDistributions' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(84,21): error TS2339: Property 'lastActivityDate' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(114,23): error TS2339: Property 'id' does not exist on type 'LedgerEntry'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts(7712,9): error TS2322: Type '"ivx_qa_only_runtime"' is not assignable...`
  - existing `backend/hono.ts` owner-auth call-site errors around lines `5063` onward.
- Freeze-risk control remains PARTIAL: prior scan found `189` freeze risks and `203` high-severity findings, still unclassified.

## Key Decisions
- Treat the autonomous drill failure as valid negative production evidence because it stopped before privileged mutation.
- Do not consume/recreate approvals or bypass the worker planner merely to produce a deployment result.
- Keep two-stage authorization:
  - `GITHUB_WRITE` must be bound to current pre-write GitHub HEAD.
  - `RENDER_DEPLOY` must be separately approved and bound to the actual resulting commit SHA.
- Treat Render deployment of the worker code as code-release parity evidence only, not autonomous execution proof.
- Environment audits must report presence/configuration state only, never secret values.
- Do not publish the newly created `ios-ivx-holdings/` application as part of IVX backend/autonomous-worker work.

## Next Steps
1. Complete source-level environment-variable audit for `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, GitHub, Render, Supabase, AWS, owner-auth, and internal deployment variables without revealing values.
2. Configure one server-only worker planning credential on `ivx-senior-dev-01`:
   - preferred: `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`;
   - alternative: `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
3. Obtain a fresh registered-owner Supabase bearer through the secure owner-session mechanism if owner-only endpoint access is required again.
4. Create a new short-lived, exact-current-SHA `GITHUB_WRITE` approval; do not reuse the prior drill approval.
5. Submit the same minimal non-functional autonomous drill and poll task, durable ledger, approval state, and worker evidence.
6. If a new commit is produced, create a separate exact-resulting-SHA `RENDER_DEPLOY` approval.
7. Verify GitHub/API/worker/Render SHA parity, health, deploy ID, and terminal durable proof.
8. Update `.rork/plans/force-sync-ivx-workspace-and-release-eve_1784928084433.plan.md` with PASS/PARTIAL/BLOCKED evidence.
